method: Analytic derivation: inverse-Laplace residue expansion, pairwise symmetrization of f f''-(f')^2, exact residue-sign counting, and Weyl counting at the right half-spectrum poles.
computation: No numerical computation, spectral-root solve, or scan was performed. Existing Weyl asymptotics and certified spectral ordering were reused.

literature.reference: U. Sumita and Y. Masuda, Classes of probability density functions having Laplace transforms with negative zeros and poles, Advances in Applied Probability 19 (1987), 632-651
B. G. Hansen, On Log-Concave and Log-Convex Infinitely Divisible Sequences and Densities, Annals of Probability 16 (1988), 1832-1839
J. Keilson, Log-concavity and log-convexity in passage time densities of diffusion and birth-death processes, Journal of Applied Probability 8 (1971), 391-398
